description: (needs account token) Rearranges a domain already on the account. It does not buy a name and it does not edit DNS at someone else's registrar. To use a domain the human already owns elsewhere (free, no transfer), connect it instead: in the dashboard (Point it here), or POST /api/v1/sites/<site_id>/connect with the site token and the JSON field name set to the domain, e.g. example.com; the answer says which A record to set. No money. Never buy anything without asking me. Never buy a domain, email or subscription for me without asking first. When something costs money, give me the payment link and let me pay.

domain.description: A domain already on this account.

to_site.description: The address of the site to point it at, e.g. myproject.dropthehassle.app (from list_sites).

name: point_domain
